description: This Java class defines a Fragment called LogFragment which contains a custom LogView for displaying log messages. It inflates a view hierarchy consisting of a ScrollView containing a LogView, and sets up behaviors such as auto-scrolling when text changes.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that encapsulates a LogView within a ScrollView and manages log display capabilities, including auto-scrolling when text changes.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView instances, setting layout parameters, appearance, and padding.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view hierarchy, sets up a TextWatcher on the LogView to auto-scroll on text update.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance for external access.
